questions.learningObjective: Compute the volume of a rectangular prism
questions.stem: An architect's brief specifies a storage box 4 m long, 3 m wide, and 2 m high. What is its volume in cubic metres
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 4 x 3 x 2 = 24 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Convert cubic metres to litres
questions.stem: A cistern holds 2 cubic metres of water. How many litres is that
questions.explanation: One cubic metre equals 1000 litres, so 2 cubic metres = 2000 litres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the volume of a triangular prism
questions.stem: A prism has a triangular base of area 6 m² and length 5 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume of a prism = base area x length = 6 x 5 = 30 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the surface area of a cube
questions.stem: An architect plans a cubic ventilation shaft with side 2 m. What is its total surface area
questions.explanation: Surface area of a cube = 6 x side² = 6 x 4 = 24 square metres.

questions.topic: Surface area of a rectangular prism
questions.learningObjective: Compute the surface area of a rectangular prism
questions.stem: A box measures 2 m by 3 m by 4 m. What is its total surface area in square metres
questions.explanation: SA = 2(lw+lh+wh) = 2(6+8+12) = 2 x 26 = 52 square metres.

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a box
questions.learningObjective: Compute the lateral surface area of a rectangular prism
questions.stem: A rectangular box is 5 m long, 2 m wide, 3 m high. What is its lateral surface area
questions.explanation: Lateral SA = perimeter of base x height = 2(5+2) x 3 = 14 x 3 = 42 square metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the volume of a cylinder
questions.stem: A cylindrical water tank has radius 2 m and height 5 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = pi x r² x h = pi x 4 x 5 = 20 pi cubic metres. Coefficient is 20.

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a cylinder
questions.learningObjective: Compute the lateral surface area of a cylinder
questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 3 m and height 4 m. What is its lateral surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Lateral SA = 2 pi r h = 2 x pi x 3 x 4 = 24 pi. Coefficient is 24.

questions.topic: Total surface area of a cylinder
questions.learningObjective: Compute the total surface area of a cylinder
questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 1 m and height 2 m. What is its total surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Total SA = 2 pi r(h+r) = 2 x pi x 1 x (2+1) = 6 pi. Coefficient is 6.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the volume of a cone
questions.stem: A conical roof has radius 3 m and height 4 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = (1/3) pi r² h = (1/3) x pi x 9 x 4 = 12 pi. Coefficient is 12.
questions.hint: Use one-third pi r squared h.

questions.learningObjective: Compare cone and cylinder volumes
questions.stem: A cone and a cylinder share the same base radius and height. How many times larger is the cylinder's volume

answer.exemplar: The cylinder's volume is 3 times larger, since a cone volume is one-third of the matching cylinder volume.

questions.explanation: Cone volume = (1/3) cylinder volume, so cylinder is 3 times the cone.
questions.hint: Recall the one-third factor for cones.

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a cone
questions.learningObjective: Compute the lateral surface area of a cone
questions.stem: A cone has radius 3 m and slant height 5 m. What is its lateral surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Lateral SA = pi r l = pi x 3 x 5 = 15 pi. Coefficient is 15.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the volume of a sphere
questions.stem: A spherical water tank has radius 3 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = (4/3) pi r³ = (4/3) x pi x 27 = 36 pi. Coefficient is 36.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the surface area of a sphere
questions.stem: A spherical dome has radius 2 m. What is its surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Surface area = 4 pi r² = 4 x pi x 4 = 16 pi. Coefficient is 16.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the curved surface area of a hemisphere
questions.stem: A hemispherical bowl has radius 3 m. What is its curved surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Curved SA of hemisphere = 2 pi r² = 2 x pi x 9 = 18 pi. Coefficient is 18.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the volume of a square pyramid
questions.stem: A pyramid has a square base of side 3 m and height 4 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = (1/3) x base area x height = (1/3) x 9 x 4 = 12 cubic metres.
questions.hint: Use one-third base area times height.

questions.learningObjective: Find the slant height of a square pyramid
questions.stem: A square pyramid has base side 6 m and perpendicular height 4 m. What is its slant height
questions.explanation: Slant height = sqrt((side/2)² + height²) = sqrt(9+16) = 5 m.
questions.hint: Use Pythagoras with half the base side.

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a pyramid
questions.learningObjective: Compute the lateral surface area of a square pyramid
questions.stem: A square pyramid has base side 4 m and slant height 5 m. What is its lateral surface area
questions.explanation: Lateral SA = 4 x (1/2 x base x slant) = 4 x (1/2 x 4 x 5) = 40 square metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compare surface area and volume scaling
questions.stem: When a solid is scaled up by factor 2, how do its surface area and volume change relative to each other

answer.exemplar: Surface area scales by 4 and volume by 8, so volume grows faster than surface area.

questions.explanation: Surface area scales as k²=4, volume as k³=8, so volume outpaces surface area.

questions.learningObjective: Compute the volume of a composite solid
questions.stem: A composite solid is a 3 m cube with a 1 m cube removed from a corner. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = 3³ - 1³ = 27 - 1 = 26 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Find the new volume after dilation
questions.stem: A solid of volume 5 m³ is dilated by scale factor 2. What is the new volume
questions.explanation: Volume scales by k³ = 8, so new volume = 5 x 8 = 40 cubic metres.
questions.hint: Multiply original volume by k cubed.

questions.learningObjective: Count unit cubes to find volume
questions.stem: A rectangular prism is 4 cubes long, 3 cubes wide, and 2 cubes high. How many unit cubes fill it
questions.explanation: Number of unit cubes = 4 x 3 x 2 = 24.
questions.hint: Multiply the three dimensions in cubes.

questions.learningObjective: Find the ratio of two volumes
questions.stem: Two similar solids have linear scale factor 3. What is the ratio of their volumes
questions.explanation: Volume ratio = k³ = 3³ = 27.

questions.topic: Surface area of an open cylinder
questions.learningObjective: Compute the surface area of an open cylinder
questions.stem: An open-top cylinder has radius 2 m and height 5 m. What is its surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Open cylinder SA = 2 pi r h + pi r² = 2 x pi x 2 x 5 + pi x 4 = 20 pi + 4 pi = 24 pi. Coefficient is 24.

questions.learningObjective: Identify an error in sphere volume formula
questions.stem: A student computes sphere volume as 4 pi r². Find the error

answer.exemplar: The student used the surface area formula instead of volume; volume is four-thirds pi r cubed.

questions.explanation: 4 pi r² is sphere surface area, not volume. Volume is (4/3) pi r³.

questions.learningObjective: Identify an error in cone volume formula
questions.stem: Which formula gives the volume of a cone with radius r and height h

options.text: One-third times pi times r squared times h.
Pi times r squared times h.
options.misconception: uses cylinder formula and forgets one-third

options.text: One-third times pi times r times h squared.
Two-thirds times pi times r cubed.

questions.explanation: Cone volume = (1/3) pi r² h. Option B is the cylinder formula.

questions.learningObjective: Identify an error in cylinder volume formula
questions.stem: A student computes cylinder volume as 2 pi r h. What is missing

answer.exemplar: The student used lateral surface area formula; volume needs pi r squared h.

questions.explanation: 2 pi r h is lateral surface area. Volume is pi r² h.
questions.hint: Volume uses base area times height.

questions.topic: Volume of a prism with a trapezoidal base
questions.learningObjective: Compute volume of a prism with trapezoidal base
questions.stem: A prism has a trapezoidal base of area 10 m² and length 6 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = base area x length = 10 x 6 = 60 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute volume from given dimensions
questions.stem: A rectangular prism is 5 m by 2 m by 3 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = 5 x 2 x 3 = 30 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Convert litres to cubic metres
questions.stem: A tank contains 5000 litres. How many cubic metres is that
questions.explanation: Divide litres by 1000: 5000/1000 = 5 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute volume of a prism with given base area
questions.stem: A prism has base area 8 m² and height 7 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = base area x height = 8 x 7 = 56 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute surface area of a cube
questions.stem: A cube has side 3 m. What is its surface area
questions.explanation: SA = 6 x 3² = 6 x 9 = 54 square metres.

questions.topic: Surface area of a rectangular prism
questions.learningObjective: Compute surface area of a box
questions.stem: A box is 1 m by 2 m by 3 m. What is its surface area

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a box
questions.learningObjective: Compute lateral surface area of a box
questions.stem: A box is 4 m by 3 m by 2 m high. What is its lateral surface area
questions.explanation: Lateral = 2(4+3) x 2 = 14 x 2 = 28 square metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute cylinder volume
questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 1 m and height 6 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = pi x 1² x 6 = 6 pi. Coefficient is 6.

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a cylinder
questions.learningObjective: Compute cylinder lateral area
questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 2 m and height 3 m. What is its lateral surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Lateral = 2 pi r h = 2 x pi x 2 x 3 = 12 pi. Coefficient is 12.

questions.topic: Total surface area of a cylinder
questions.learningObjective: Compute cylinder total surface area
questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 2 m and height 2 m. What is its total surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Total = 2 pi r(h+r) = 2 x pi x 2 x (2+2) = 16 pi. Coefficient is 16.

questions.learningObjective: Compute cone volume
questions.stem: A cone has radius 2 m and height 6 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = (1/3) pi x 4 x 6 = 8 pi. Coefficient is 8.
questions.hint: Use one-third pi r squared h.

questions.learningObjective: Relate cone and cylinder volumes
questions.stem: A cone has the same base and height as a cylinder. What fraction of the cylinder's volume does the cone occupy

answer.exemplar: The cone occupies one-third of the cylinder's volume.

questions.explanation: Cone volume is one-third of cylinder volume with same base and height.

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a cone
questions.learningObjective: Compute cone lateral area
questions.stem: A cone has radius 4 m and slant height 5 m. What is its lateral surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Lateral = pi r l = pi x 4 x 5 = 20 pi. Coefficient is 20.

questions.learningObjective: Compute sphere volume
questions.stem: A sphere has radius 6 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = (4/3) pi x 216 = 288 pi. Coefficient is 288.

questions.learningObjective: Compute sphere surface area
questions.stem: A sphere has radius 3 m. What is its surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Surface area = 4 pi r² = 4 x pi x 9 = 36 pi. Coefficient is 36.

questions.learningObjective: Compute hemisphere total surface area
questions.stem: A hemisphere has radius 2 m. What is its total surface area including base in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Total SA = 3 pi r² = 3 x pi x 4 = 12 pi. Coefficient is 12.

questions.learningObjective: Compute pyramid volume
questions.stem: A pyramid has a rectangular base 4 m by 3 m and height 6 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = (1/3) x 12 x 6 = 24 cubic metres.
questions.hint: Use one-third base area times height.

questions.learningObjective: Find slant height of a pyramid
questions.stem: A square pyramid has base side 10 m and perpendicular height 12 m. What is its slant height
questions.explanation: Slant height = sqrt(5² + 12²) = sqrt(25+144) = 13 m.
questions.hint: Use Pythagoras with half the base side.

questions.topic: Lateral surface area of a pyramid
questions.learningObjective: Compute lateral surface area of a pyramid
questions.stem: A square pyramid has base side 6 m and slant height 5 m. What is its lateral surface area
questions.explanation: Lateral SA = 4 x (1/2 x 6 x 5) = 60 square metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compare surface area and volume scaling
questions.stem: When a solid is scaled by factor 3, by what factor does its volume increase

options.misconception: squares the scale factor instead of cubing
uses linear scale factor for volume
doubles then triples the scale factor

questions.explanation: Volume scales as k³ = 3³ = 27.

questions.learningObjective: Compute composite solid volume
questions.stem: A composite solid is a 4 m cube with a 2 m cube removed. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = 4³ - 2³ = 64 - 8 = 56 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Find new volume after dilation
questions.stem: A solid of volume 8 m³ is dilated by scale factor 3. What is the new volume
questions.explanation: Volume scales by k³ = 27, so new volume = 8 x 27 = 216 cubic metres.
questions.hint: Multiply original volume by k cubed.

questions.learningObjective: Count unit cubes
questions.stem: A rectangular prism is 5 cubes long, 2 cubes wide, and 3 cubes high. How many unit cubes fill it
questions.explanation: Number of unit cubes = 5 x 2 x 3 = 30.
questions.hint: Multiply the three dimensions in cubes.

questions.learningObjective: Find volume ratio
questions.stem: Two similar solids have linear scale factor 2. What is the ratio of their volumes
questions.explanation: Volume ratio = k³ = 2³ = 8.

questions.topic: Surface area of an open cylinder
questions.learningObjective: Compute open cylinder surface area
questions.stem: An open-top cylinder has radius 3 m and height 4 m. What is its surface area in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Open cylinder SA = 2 pi r h + pi r² = 2 x pi x 3 x 4 + pi x 9 = 24 pi + 9 pi = 33 pi. Coefficient is 33.

questions.learningObjective: Identify sphere surface area formula
questions.stem: A student computes sphere surface area as (4/3) pi r³. Find the error

answer.exemplar: The student used the volume formula instead of surface area; surface area is 4 pi r squared.

questions.explanation: (4/3) pi r³ is sphere volume. Surface area is 4 pi r².

questions.learningObjective: Identify cone lateral area formula
questions.stem: A student computes cone lateral area as pi r h. What is missing

answer.exemplar: The student forgot the slant height; lateral area is pi r l.

questions.explanation: pi r h is not a standard formula. Lateral area of a cone is pi r l using slant height.

questions.learningObjective: Identify cylinder surface area formula
questions.stem: Which expression gives the total surface area of a cylinder with radius r and height h

options.misconception: uses lateral area only and omits bases
uses volume formula instead of surface area
multiplies base area by height incorrectly

questions.explanation: Total surface area of a cylinder = 2 pi r(h+r).

questions.topic: Volume of a prism with a trapezoidal base
questions.learningObjective: Compute trapezoidal prism volume
questions.stem: A prism has a trapezoidal base of area 12 m² and length 5 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = base area x length = 12 x 5 = 60 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute rectangular prism volume
questions.stem: A rectangular prism is 6 m by 4 m by 2 m. What is its volume
questions.explanation: Volume = 6 x 4 x 2 = 48 cubic metres.

questions.learningObjective: Convert cubic centimetres to millilitres
questions.stem: A container holds 750 cubic centimetres. How many millilitres is that
questions.explanation: One cubic centimetre equals one millilitre, so 750 cubic centimetres = 750 millilitres.

questions.learningObjective: Compute cylinder volume
questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 3 m and height 2 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = pi x 9 x 2 = 18 pi. Coefficient is 18.

questions.learningObjective: Compute cone volume
questions.stem: A cone has radius 6 m and height 3 m. What is its volume in terms of pi
questions.explanation: Volume = (1/3) pi x 36 x 3 = 36 pi. Coefficient is 36.
questions.hint: Use one-third pi r squared h.
